name: command
title: Command
description: Composable command menu (command palette) with search.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import type { ComboboxRootEmits, ComboboxRootProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { ComboboxRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ComboboxRootProps>(), {
  open: true,
  modelValue: '',
});

const emits = defineEmits<ComboboxRootEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <ComboboxRoot
    data-slot="command"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-command"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </ComboboxRoot>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-command {
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--popover);
  color: var(--popover-foreground);
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
import type { DialogRootEmits, DialogRootProps } from 'reka-ui';
import Command from './Command.vue';
import { Dialog, DialogContent } from '@/components/ui/dialog';

const props = defineProps<DialogRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<DialogRootEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog
    data-slot="command-dialog"
    v-bind="forwarded"
  >
    <DialogContent class="sigma-ui-command-dialog">
      <Command class="sigma-ui-command-dialog__command">
        <slot />
      </Command>
    </DialogContent>
  </Dialog>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-command-dialog {
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.sigma-ui-command-dialog__command [cmdk-group-heading] {
  padding-right: calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
  padding-left: calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.sigma-ui-command-dialog__command [cmdk-group]:not([hidden]) ~ [cmdk-group] {
  padding-top: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-command-dialog__command [cmdk-group] {
  padding-right: calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
  padding-left: calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
}

.sigma-ui-command-dialog__command [cmdk-input-wrapper] svg {
  width: calc(var(--spacing) * 5);
  height: calc(var(--spacing) * 5);
}

.sigma-ui-command-dialog__command [cmdk-input] {
  height: calc(var(--spacing) * 12);
}

.sigma-ui-command-dialog__command [cmdk-item] {
  padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 3) calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
}

.sigma-ui-command-dialog__command [cmdk-item] svg {
  width: calc(var(--spacing) * 5);
  height: calc(var(--spacing) * 5);
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import type { ComboboxEmptyProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { ComboboxEmpty } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<ComboboxEmptyProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <ComboboxEmpty
    data-slot="command-empty"
    v-bind="{ ...props, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-command-empty"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </ComboboxEmpty>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-command-empty {
  padding-top: calc(var(--spacing) * 6);
  padding-bottom: calc(var(--spacing) * 6);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  text-align: center;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import type { ComboboxGroupProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { ComboboxGroup, ComboboxLabel } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<ComboboxGroupProps & {
  /** Label shown above the group items. */
  heading?: string;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <ComboboxGroup
    data-slot="command-group"
    v-bind="{ ...props, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-command-group text-xs"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <ComboboxLabel
      v-if="heading"
      class="sigma-ui-command-group__heading"
    >
      {{ heading }}
    </ComboboxLabel>
    <slot />
  </ComboboxGroup>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-command-group {
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1);
  color: var(--foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-command-group [cmdk-group-heading] {
  padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5) calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1rem;
}

.sigma-ui-command-group__heading {
  padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5) calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1rem;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

<template>
  <ComboboxItem

    class="sigma-ui-command-item"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </ComboboxItem>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-command-item {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5) calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: default;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  line-height: 1.25rem;
  outline: none;
  user-select: none;
}

.sigma-ui-command-item[data-highlighted] {
  background-color: var(--secondary);
  color: var(--secondary-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-command-item[data-disabled] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import type { ComboboxSeparatorProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { ComboboxSeparator } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<ComboboxSeparatorProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <ComboboxSeparator
    data-slot="command-separator"
    v-bind="{ ...props, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-command-separator"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </ComboboxSeparator>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-command-separator {
  height: 1px;
  margin-right: calc(var(--spacing) * -1);
  margin-left: calc(var(--spacing) * -1);
  background-color: var(--border);
}
</style>
